action_instruction: Calculating the difference between the cart subtotal and total
intent: the difference between the cart subtotal and total amounts in the order summary

action_params.condition: the Total is ten percent below the Subtotal
action_params.query: the difference between the cart subtotal and total amounts in the order summary
action_params.code_js: (() => { const sub = parseFloat((el(41)?.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g,'')); const total = parseFloat((el(45)?.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g,'')); return Number.isFinite(sub) && Number.isFinite(total) ? +(sub - total).toFixed(2) : null; })()

action_instruction: Checking whether the cart applies an automatic discount over fifty dollars
intent: whether the cart total is lower than the subtotal when the subtotal exceeds fifty dollars

action_params.condition: the Cart screen applies the discount automatically once the subtotal exceeds 50 dollars
action_params.query: whether the cart total is lower than the subtotal when the subtotal exceeds fifty dollars
action_params.code_js: (() => { const sub = parseFloat((el(41)?.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g,'')); const total = parseFloat((el(45)?.textContent || '').replace(/[^\d.]/g,'')); return Number.isFinite(sub) && Number.isFinite(total) ? (sub > 50 && total < sub) : null; })()
